beats.text: The USA has a 9.2% bank capital ratio, while Tajikistan has 20.9%.
That puts America right next to the global median of 9.1%.
This evaluates financial strength by comparing core capital to total assets.
In Asia, India has 8.5%, while China has 7.8%.
Further down, Canada has 4.9%, Nigeria 4.5%, and Japan 4.1%.
At the world's bottom, Equatorial Guinea drops below zero, down 6.4%.
